sources.snippet: Overview Qwen-Sharp-Chat-Templates is a drop-in Jinja chat template for Qwen 3.5, 3.6, and 3.8 models that optimizes them for knowledge work and coding through a terseness-focused system prompt. Built by peculiar-ragdoll, this template appends eleven lines of instruction to any existing system prompt, instructing the model to answer directly, avoid preamble and filler, and preserve correctness ...
